title: Achieving High Accuracy in Predicting the Probability of Periprosthetic Joint Infection From Synovial Fluid in Patients Undergoing Hip or Knee Arthroplasty: The Development and Validation of a Multivariable Machine Learning Algorithm.
summary: Original full text evaluates a pruned decision-tree probability model on 17,165 train/test and 5,601 temporally later validation synovial-fluid samples against a modified 2018 ICM reference; test/validation sensitivity and specificity were about 99%, with fewer inconclusive classifications. This is a bounded diagnostic validation, not prospective outcome benefit. AI role: Multivariable machine-learning probability model using synovial-fluid tests. The article appeared in Cureus.
